title: Inverse Short-Time FFT
text: Nonparametric estimate of spectrum using short-time fast Fourier transform (STFT) method, 2 inputs, 1 output, no direct feedthrough; {Analysis window length} sets the length of analysis window, {Overlap between consecutive windows (in samples)} sets the overlap length and {FFT length}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Analysis window length
params.values: Length of analysis window 512 (default) | positive integer greater than 1

params.name: FFT length
params.values: FFT length 1024 (default) | positive integer greater than or equal to 2
